title: Special-Order Air-Quality Accessories Collected with the Replacement System Installations Deposit
content:
# Air-quality accessory share collected with the deposit

## Rule

The air-quality accessory share of a Replacement System Installations contract deposit collects special-order air-quality accessories with the deposit, taken on the total of every UV germicidal light, media air cleaner and steam humidifier charge on the contract:

- a total of $1200.00 or more is collected at 100 percent;
- a total above zero but below $1200.00 at 50 percent;
- a contract with none of those accessories adds nothing.

The share is rounded to the cent half up. Other accessories — the smart thermostat upgrade, the whole-home surge protector and the condensate pump — are not part of the total.

## Boundaries and cases (hypothetical contracts)

| Air-quality accessories charged | Total | Share collected |
|---|---|---|
| UV germicidal light | $849.00 | $424.50 |
| Media air cleaner | $1195.00 | $597.50 |
| UV germicidal light and media air cleaner | $2044.00 | $2044.00 |
| Steam humidifier | $2450.00 | $2450.00 |
| Hypothetical total of exactly $1200.00 | $1200.00 | $1200.00 |
| Surge protector only | $0.00 | Nothing |
